question: How does knowing the Lord as enjoyer and friend bring peace?
premises: the Lord is enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities
the Lord is great lord of all worlds
the Lord is friend of all beings
knowing divine principle liberates even while situated as is
inference: Knowing the Lord as enjoyer, supreme lord, and friend of all beings brings peace and liberation even while one remains situated as is.
uncertainties: bhoktā-tyaktaphalatvāt is an editorial gloss phrase rather than a single lexical token
plain_english: Knowing me as the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, great lord of all worlds, and friend of all beings, one attains peace; knowing such divine principle, one is liberated even while situated as is.
